# JSON Dev Tool

- Canonical site: https://json-tools.thanhlv.com/
- Main app route: https://json-tools.thanhlv.com/editor
- Purpose: browser-based JSON utilities for formatting, diff, merge, query, schema, CSV, privacy masking, pipeline transforms, and JSON Patch.

## Primary routes
- /editor
- /diff
- /merge
- /query
- /pipeline
- /privacy
- /tree
- /convert
- /schema-generate
- /schema-mock
- /schema-validate
- /csv
- /escape
- /patch
